title: Neon Cycles deployment diagram
description: How Neon Cycles runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. The browser runs the whole game; the Worker checks the sign-in, joins the engine file and serves the rest.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot engine (WebAssembly and WebGL 2) and the whole game.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/neon-cycles*, ahead of the games hub's route.

nodes.name: neon-cycles Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the sign-in check on the page and the joined index.wasm; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: Godot web export
artifacts.description: index.html, index.js, index.pck and the engine as index.wasm.0, .1, …, exported with Godot 4.7.2 by build.mjs.

artifacts.name: boot.js, shell.css, favicon.svg and _headers
artifacts.description: The page's script and stylesheet and a strict Content-Security-Policy, copied into dist/ unchanged.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page, the engine and its data.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page needs a signed-in player.
